item.title: All Mewgenics locations
item.description: What seems like a simple journey quickly gets out of hand, as each completed Mewgenics location opens up another, more difficult path.

item.title: All Mewgenics classes
item.description: The makeup of your team can vary wildly, and with a ton of Mewgenics classes up for selection, it can be difficult to know which to pick.

item.title: Mewgenics review - 100 hours later, this is the deepest strategy game I've played in years
item.description: From the maker of The Binding of Issac and Super Meat Boy, Mewgenics mixes cat eugenics with deep, layered strategy, but its humor misses the mark.

item.title: Nioh 3 Kodama locations
item.description: Here are all the Nioh 3 Kodama locations we've found so far, so reap the Kodama Merits and extra Elixir capacity awarded for your service.

item.title: The next Arc Raiders Expedition wipe will be easier to max out than the first, but you'll get a bonus for hitting both
item.description: Embark Studios details the second Arc Raiders Expedition and what rewards you’ll get for choosing to wipe, with repeat participant bonuses.

item.title: The founder of Minecraft-style sandbox Hytale warns Roblox creators to "pay attention" to its AI messaging
item.description: Hypixel’s founder claims Roblox creators should be wary of its AI-led direction, while Hytale takes “as little as possible” from modders.

item.title: Deadlock release date estimate, latest news, trailers, and more
item.description: Find out everything you need to know about the upcoming MOBA-shooter hybrid from Valve and what to expect from a release date and gameplay.

item.title: In a familiar twist of fate, Cyberpunk 2077's TCG adaptation needs a lot more time in the oven
item.description: While WeirdCo and CDPR's Cyberpunk 2077 TCG perfectly captures the RPG’s 'rags to riches' grind, its mechanics are a little too ambitious.

item.title: The next Diablo 4 class reveal has a date, but it's the promise of something new for D2 Resurrected that has me smiling
item.description: Blizzard dates the second Diablo 4 Lord of Hatred class reveal as part of the 30th Anniversary Spotlight, and D2R will be there as well.

item.title: Warhammer 40k Space Marine 2 is cheaper than ever, just in time for more Year 2 content
item.description: Warhammer 40k Space Marine 2 is a fantastic entry in the franchise, and you can grab it at its lowest price before more content arrives.
